propositions: Extract the except spine of run() into interpret_failure() and relocate it to structured_run.py, not failure.py or a new file.

The three exception arms must preserve order (UsageLimitExceeded, then LLMError, then broad Exception) with translate_sampling_parameter_rejection tried first, or typed failures get misclassified as provider outages.
Arm-ordering tests must assert type(x) is rather than isinstance because LLMConfigError subclasses LLMUnavailableError, making isinstance checks pass vacuously.
The extracted function must preserve the raised exception type for each arm while attaching classified disposition as .outcome metadata.
An end-to-end test through the real run() must verify run() still routes through the extracted seam.
Stale CURRENT(runner.py:NNN) labels in test_llm_failure_matrix.py should be retargeted to structured_run.interpret_failure without line numbers to prevent rot.
